Email from [[Steve Sanders|Stephen Sanders]], organizer and tournament director of the [[2026 Retro League]], to Retro League players announcing the final result of [[2026 Retro League Event 1]] ([[Premiere - Hoth]]), sent 20 March 2026. It congratulates [[Ian Monteith]] on winning, explains the cumulative scoring (3 points per win, 1 per loss, 4 bonus points for first and 2 for second) and lists all 77 players with their cumulative scores.

== Source ==
* Email "2026 SWCCG Retro League Event 1 Premiere - Hoth Final Result" from Stephen Sanders to Retro League players, 20 March 2026. Received by [[Bill Bisco]] as a player and printed from Gmail to PDF on 13 October 2026; provided by Bill.

== Changes ==
* Redacted copy: every email address and the Gmail print header's page address are blacked out, and the pages are rasterised. The message text, names and standings are otherwise unchanged.
